key_insight: Preserving neural-network plasticity improves reinforcement learning robustness on harder stochastic tasks, but TD instability dominates in the most challenging settings.
engineering_relevance: These findings may inform robust learning-based engineering controllers under sensor and actuator noise, though solid-mechanics applications were not evaluated.
method: Train Soft Actor-Critic agents on three DeepMind Control tasks.
Introduce controlled observation and action noise.
Evaluate plasticity-preserving methods, including resets and layer normalization.
evidence_signal: Across three tasks, plasticity-preserving methods improved robustness on the two harder tasks as observation noise increased, while resets plus layer normalization underperformed resets alone at every tested observation-noise level.
watch_item: Noise effects depend on task difficulty, so plasticity-preserving interventions should not be assumed to resolve severe TD instability.
paper_title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
